page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with two footnotes below the text. No margin notes. Running head centred at top, page number at top left, catchword at the right below the last line.

main_text.head: EPIST. I.
main_text.p: Epistola Synagogæ Samaritanorum, quæ est in urbe Sichem, seu Napolous, ad clarissimum virum Josephum Scaligerum, interprete Joanne Morino ; fidem suam, mores, ritusque suos fusius in ea explicant, simulque exponunt, quâ in re à Judæis discrepent.

p.i: Epistolæ illæ nunquam venerunt in manus Scaligeri, has misit Perescius ad Morinum. Exemplar Autographum dicitur asservari in Bibliotheca Regis Christianissimi.

main_text.p: IN nomine Domini{a}Dei magni & potentis, & terribilis, qui faciem non suscipit neque munus accipit.

In nomine Domini fortis, Dei Israël, cujus est virtus, det mihi virtutem, ut respondeam petitionibus tuis, Joseph fili Scaligeri. Si interrogas de Observatione Sabbati, nos observamus illud, sicut dixit dominus: {b}Non egredietur quisquam de loco suo in die Sabbati, & requie-

page.notes: The catchword "vit" is printed at the right, below the last line, and completes "requievit"; the paragraph ends at the hyphen "requie-" as printed. The first word of the italic line is printed as "qui" and the italic letters are read with some uncertainty, but no word is marked [?]. The long s in "suam", "suos", "Perescius", "asservari" and "Christianissimi" is read as plain s. The printed "qvâ" and "qvæ" are normalised to "quâ" and "quæ" under the u/v rule. The printed "Devt" and "reqvie" are normalised to "Deut" and "requie". The scan has heavy paper speckle along the left edge and the right edge, which is not transcribed.
